name: Article 1, § 1, point 17; Regulation (EU) 2023/956 – Article 27 a – 86
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulation (EU) 2023/956 as regards the extension of its scope to downstream goods and anti-circumvention measures
part_text: The Commission shall continuously monitor the situation at Union level with a view to monitoring the impact of the CBAM on the Union internal market. Where the Commission, taking into account the relevant evidence, considers that the inclusion of a good in Annex I causes severe harm to the Union internal market due to serious and unforeseen circumstances related to the impact on the prices of goods, it is empowered to adopt delegated acts in accordance with Article 28 to temporarily remove this good from Annex I until those serious and unforeseeable circumstances have passed; Where a good is temporarily removed from Annex I pursuant to paragraph 1 of this Article, the Commission shall, in accordance with the applicable Union financial rules and subject to the availability of appropriations, ensure that appropriate financial support is made available to operators in all the productive sectors within the Union directly affected by the serious and unforeseen circumstances referred to in paragraph 1, including operators producing the good concerned or using that good in their production process. Such support shall, where appropriate, be financed from revenues generated by the sale of CBAM certificates and shall be proportionate to the harm suffered and not result in overcompensation.
